clues: This town sits by a lake. It is in the heart of Burkina Faso, north of the capital.
Though the land around is arid and dry, the lake lets people farm its shore all year round.
France set up an outpost here and built roads. It backed cotton, but changed local life very little.
Green beans are grown here, and they are sold in Paris. In winter, they fill the market there.
A big Catholic mission stands by the lake. It sits on the east shore of Lac du Bam.
